description: This line plot illustrates the loss comparison between two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, during their Embedding and LM Head training stages, as referenced in the paper “RedWhale: An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining.” The x-axis, labeled “Step,” is linearly scaled from 0 to 60,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is logarithmically scaled, ranging from approximately 2 × 10⁰ to 1.2 × 10¹, with major grid lines at 2 × 10⁰, 3 × 10⁰, 4 × 10⁰, 6 × 10⁰, 10¹, and 1.2 × 10¹. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Ex1 Loss” (solid blue line with blue circular markers), “Ex2 Loss” (solid cyan line with cyan circular markers), “Ex1 Validation Loss” (dashed blue line with blue circular markers), and “Ex2 Validation Loss” (dashed cyan line with cyan circular markers). At Step 0, Ex1 Loss begins at approximately 3.7, while Ex2 Loss starts higher at around 11.0. Both training losses decrease sharply in the initial steps: Ex1 Loss drops to about 2.1 by Step 10,000 and gradually stabilizes near 1.8 by Step 60,000. Ex2 Loss falls steeply to approximately 2.2 by Step 20,000 and then slowly declines to around 2.0 by Step 60,000. The validation losses follow similar trends but remain consistently higher: Ex1 Validation Loss starts at ~5.0, drops to ~3.2 by Step 10,000, and stabilizes near 3.1. Ex2 Validation Loss begins at ~5.0, declines to ~3.2 by Step 20,000, and stabilizes near 3.3. All four lines exhibit diminishing returns after approximately 20,000 steps, indicating convergence.
